title: PREMARKET LIVE: The Trading Floor | NFLX SPCX Earnings Preview
speaker: Arete Trading host

macro_themes.view: Neoclouds and data-center power plays are in trouble; a data-center IPO down 33% day one signals a problem.
Treasuries rallying either on less corporate issuance or recession defensiveness; either way not great for tech.
Expects the S&P 493 to outgrow the Mag 7 next year; favours energy, beverages, defensives.

calls.condition: If ES holds 7751 it might form a bottom; otherwise 7550 on the table.
calls.reason: ES rejecting at value area after 4h RSI divergence; leaning toward the bounce being only an oversold bounce, though holding 7751 could form a bottom. Expects ES to outperform NQ.
calls.quote: I'm really very close now to saying it's just an oversold bounce and we're probably going lower.

calls.reason: Expects Nasdaq to underperform the S&P; suggests pair trade long SPY / short QQQ.
calls.quote: you just go long the SPY and short, uh, the Q's and uh, it tends to work out really well

calls.reason: Neocloud earnings on the 22nd could be a 'dumpster fire'; even a good quarter likely gets sold. He has been shorting it, though mentions cheap 170 calls as a lottery.
calls.quote: NBIS could be a freaking dumpster fire... if they have a really good quarter, they're just going to sell the hell out of it.

calls.reason: Data-center power names (and uranium) are 'toast'; a data-center IPO trading 33% below its price signals data centers have a problem.
calls.quote: Be to me is probably like the easiest short in the world.

calls.reason: Energy is the only sector that makes sense to him right now; EOG chart 'looks fantastic'.
calls.quote: This looks fantastic. Energy is the only thing that makes any sense to me.

calls.condition: Buy on a break through resistance.
calls.reason: Beverage/bottler names undervalued and should keep grinding as growth broadens beyond the Mag 7; interested on a breakout.
calls.quote: I am really interested um in this name on a break if I can get through

calls.reason: Likes the Amazon news and earnings, but has trust issues with the market and won't chase until stability.
calls.quote: I like the fact that you're holding, but I don't trust anything here right now until I see some level of stability.

notes: Host says 'hit your level yesterday on Friday' though listing implies Wed Oct 21; date left as listing. ES 7550 treated as downside target ('can get down to 7550').
